description: Every product an organization is linked to, with its role on each (maker, contractor, supplier, operator, agency), the relation status, the quote and the source: "which products does Aerojet Rocketdyne have", "what did Almatech build". The organization is matched by id or part of its name. role narrows to a role containing that text, for example supplier-like words ("tanks") or "prime contractor". Only stated links are listed.

maker.description: Organization name or part of it, or its id (org-...)

role.description: Only links whose role contains this text, for example engine, prime contractor, structure

name: products_by_maker
title: Products of an organization
